name: My Zypps - Ounce - Gelonade
description:
Sun-grown, full-bud, full ounce. The My Zypps Gelonade ounce delivers a full 28 grams of quality sun-grown flower — cured for full flavor and a smooth, even burn.

Gelonade brings a bright, citrus-meets-dessert profile: zesty lemonade up front with creamy gelato sweetness and a smooth, subtly earthy finish.

28G sun-grown flower — full ounce of whole bud
Best value — full-ounce pricing at the lowest cost per gram
Signature Gelonade flavor — zesty lemonade with creamy gelato sweetness

My Zypps Gelonade is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
